title: Plans to Extract Geothermal Energy in Sembawang and Other Potential Sites
what_it_is: Plans to Extract Geothermal Energy in Sembawang and Other Potential Sites

sections.label: Singapore geothermal energy potential study
sections.summary: Singapore lacks near-surface geothermal resources, but an NTU-led study found deep heat in Admiralty could potentially generate electricity, though no immediate plans exist.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Singapore does not have sufficient near-surface underground heat resources such as underground hot water or steam to deploy conventional geothermal systems.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: However, with the newer developments in geothermal technology, there is potential to harness heat that is deep underground for power generation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This exploratory study that is led by researchers from the Nanyang Technological University (NTU) found that in Admiralty, the heat at a depth of four to five kilometres could be sufficient for electricity generation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: However, these new geothermal technologies that can harness heat at such great depths have yet to be commercially deployed.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: There are therefore no immediate plans for geothermal energy production in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To holistically assess Singapore's geothermal potential, the Energy Market Authority (EMA) will be launching a tender later this year to conduct a geophysical survey across Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: That survey will take a few years to complete.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: It will provide additional data to help in the assessment of geothermal energy as a potential source of renewable energy in Singapore.
